  "summary": "Caches a SHA-256 hash of each descriptor's canonical string representation inside WalletDescriptor and uses it for canonical equivalence checks in HasWalletDescriptor and UpdateFrom. Replaces the default constructor and serialization macro on WalletDescriptor with a FromStream factory function, makes its descriptor pointer const, and deduplicates hardened indicator apostrophe handling in descriptor string serialization.",
  "problem": "Comparing wallet descriptors via HasWalletDescriptor repeatedly recomputed the full canonical descriptor string, causing a performance regression during descriptor lookups and wallet loading. Holding the full string in memory to avoid recomputation would consume significant memory for rarely displayed strings.",

This can be sped up by holding the canonical string in memory... To reduce memory usage, this string is further hashed so that the comparison operates over the hash of the canonical string.'"

result.summary: Caches a SHA-256 hash of each descriptor's canonical string representation inside WalletDescriptor and uses it for canonical equivalence checks in HasWalletDescriptor and UpdateFrom. Replaces the default constructor and serialization macro on WalletDescriptor with a FromStream factory function, makes its descriptor pointer const, and deduplicates hardened indicator apostrophe handling in descriptor string serialization.
result.problem: Comparing wallet descriptors via HasWalletDescriptor repeatedly recomputed the full canonical descriptor string, causing a performance regression during descriptor lookups and wallet loading. Holding the full string in memory to avoid recomputation would consume significant memory for rarely displayed strings.
evidence: The PR description states this change fixes a performance regression reported in PR #35445 (achow101 citing #35445#issuecomment-5633483553).

Commit 64abb3e8d3 notes: 'The canonical string comparison was slow because it would compute the canonical string for each comparison. This can be sped up by holding the canonical string in memory... To reduce memory usage, this string is further hashed so that the comparison operates over the hash of the canonical string.'
result.scope_notes: Also adds v31.1 release binaries and compatibility expectations to the wallet backwards-compatibility Python tests.
result.card: This pull request caches a SHA-256 hash of the canonical descriptor string in WalletDescriptor to speed up descriptor equivalence checks in HasWalletDescriptor. Previously, descriptor comparisons regenerated the full canonical string on every invocation, causing a performance regression introduced in PR 35445 during descriptor lookups. Storing a 32-byte hash rather than the full canonical string prevents unnecessary memory overhead while avoiding string formatting during comparisons. The PR also makes the descriptor pointer const, replaces default serialization with a FromStream factory, and adds v31.1 binaries to backwards-compatibility tests.
